A consumer fintech (8M users): a Technology & SaaS program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Achala IT Solutions team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Fraud rings scaled faster than rules; manual review burning margin.
Alternative credit signals unused; underwriting blunt. Regulator attention rising; evidence maturity lagging.

The streaming decision hub scores onboarding and transactions with network analytics and policy layers under replay; alternative-data features (consented) improved underwriting quality; and compliance-as-code mapped controls to licensing conditions — the audit became evidence sampling.
